short: Qubit and T-gate budgets for fault-tolerant hardware

statements.markdown: reaching early hardware will require further orders-of-magnitude improvements
statements.note: The non-Born–Oppenheimer benchmark uses $5{,}616$ qubits for the system register before workspace. Table S1 gives a teraquop ceiling range of $500$ to $2{,}000$ logical qubits. Even a circuit with a smaller $T$ count would need a different system encoding to fit that qubit range.

statements.section: D.2 Fault-tolerant capability regimes and hardware horizons
statements.note: The teraquop midpoint in Table S1 is $1{,}000$ qubits and $10^9$ $T$ gates. The P450 circuit uses $333$ qubits and has a $T$-count bound of about $1.31\times10^9$. Its product is below $10^{12}$, while its $T$-count bound exceeds the midpoint of the corresponding gate budget.
